descFull: 让远程 Mac 在任意设备上获得原生级体验。支持 UU远程 与 CrossDesk 的显示与触控增强：手机、平板、电脑各有专属屏幕，画面铺满、字号随屏，原生触屏手势，App 资源库。Make your remote Mac native on any device: display and touch enhancements for UU Remote and CrossDesk, with a dedicated screen for every phone, tablet and computer, native touch gestures and an App Library.
